scope: Definition headers shrink from 88 to 32 native bytes; matching metadata belongs only to parameterized definitions. The driver borrows the engine, leaving outcome construction and cleanup in its caller. Stored grouped arguments test four immutable words together before advancing, with a scalar tail for structural words and window ends. Native profile training expands from 17 to 18 workloads. Whole-binary comparisons include compiler code placement.

previous_profile_comparison.scope: Alternating full-process child user-plus-system CPU comparison against the retained 17-workload profile build. Input reads, construction, execution and checksum output are timed. One warmup precedes nine retained repetitions; every checksum is verified.

allocation_diagnostic.scope: Engine construction and execution; excludes host source buffers, Rust stack, allocator overhead and pdfTeX memory. Counts are diagnostic requests, not process RSS.

instruction_diagnostics.scope: Valgrind Callgrind Ir for the complete native process; simulated instructions do not measure CPU performance.
